name: Memories on the Shoreline
source:
Melody wanted a break from her stressful med classes— so when spring break came around, she dragged her best friend Shion with her to the beach. However, things don't go quite so smoothly when they meet Brennan, a local fisherman, and Crylis... a mermaid?!

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/memories-on-the-shoreline]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅洛迪想从繁重的医学课程中喘口气，于是春假一到，就拉着最好的朋友Shion一起去了海边。然而，当她们遇到当地渔夫布伦南，以及克里利斯…一条人鱼？！事情就没那么顺利了。

[摘自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/memories-on-the-shoreline]Itch.io[/url]]
